+"""Loopback fixture-only form adapter to the accepted pure proposal validator.
+
+No decision/session/ledger/repository write. Inputs never confer authority.
+"""
+
+from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlsplit, unquote
+
+from vrae.reviewing import (
+    ReviewCommandProposal,
+    CoverageAcknowledgementProposal,
+    ReviewTarget,
+    ReviewError,
+    validate_proposal,
+)
+from vrae.reviewing.canonical import canonical, COMMAND_LIMIT
+
+from .contracts import ConsoleError, refuse
+from .fixtures import FixtureAuthority, FixtureRepository
+from .native import NativeVerifier
+
+BODY_LIMIT = 24_576
+CONTENT_TYPE = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
+
+
+class ProposalPreview:
+    def __init__(self, service, context, *, test_only=False, synthetic_fixtures=False):
+        if (
+            test_only is not True
+            or synthetic_fixtures is not True
+            or type(service.authority) is not FixtureAuthority
+            or type(service.repository) is not FixtureRepository
+            or type(service.native) is not NativeVerifier
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("TEST_ONLY_FIXTURE_REQUIRED")
+        service._scope(context)
+        self.service, self.context = service, context
+
+    def _context(self, context):
+        if context is not self.context:
+            refuse("UNAUTHORIZED")
+        self.service._scope(context)
+
+    def read(self, context, task_id, version, draft, target):
+        self._context(context)
+        return self.service.target(context, task_id, version, draft, target)
+
+    def validate(self, context, task_id, raw, content_type):
+        """Untrusted bounded form -> native command -> native pure validator.
+
+        Claim identities are submitted explicitly, never silently repaired. The
+        target is reloaded/replayed on every action. No caller trust or actor.
+        """
+        self._context(context)
+        # Assignment check precedes parsing or any report/source read.
+        self.service.detail(context, task_id)
+        if type(raw) is not bytes or len(raw) > BODY_LIMIT or content_type != CONTENT_TYPE:
+            refuse("INVALID_INPUT")
+        try:
+            value = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
+            # parse_qsl alone tolerates malformed percent escapes.
+            import re
+
+            if re.search(r"%(?![0-9a-fA-F]{2})", value):
+                refuse("INVALID_INPUT")
+            pairs = parse_qsl(
+                value,
+                keep_blank_values=True,
+                strict_parsing=True,
+                encoding="utf-8",
+                errors="strict",
+                max_num_fields=64,
+            )
+            if len(dict(pairs)) != len(pairs):
+                refuse("INVALID_INPUT")
+            f = dict(pairs)
+            if not {"version", "draft", "target"} <= f.keys():
+                refuse("INVALID_INPUT")
+            if not f["version"].isascii() or not f["version"].isdigit() or len(f["version"]) > 4:
+                refuse("INVALID_INPUT")
+            task, dossier = self.read(context, task_id, int(f["version"]), f["draft"], f["target"])
+            t = dossier["review_target"]["target"]
+            expected = {"version", "draft", "target", "action", "reason"}
+            expected.update(
+                f"{k}.{i}"
+                for i in range(len(t["claims"]))
+                for k in ("guard", "binding", "pointer", "disposition")
+            )
+            section_fields = {"section." + s for s in t["required_sections"]}
+            # Missing sections go to the native validator; extra fields fail closed.
+            if set(f) - section_fields != expected or set(f) - expected - section_fields:
+                refuse("INVALID_INPUT")
+            is_review = t["kind"] == "L1_NATIVE"
+            if not is_review and f["action"] != "SIMULATED_INTERNAL_SCOPE_ACK":
+                refuse("INVALID_INPUT")
+            command = {
+                "contract_version": "ra3d-review-proposal-offline-v1",
+                "kind": "REVIEW_COMMAND_PROPOSAL" if is_review else "COVERAGE_ACK_PROPOSAL",
+                "tenant_id": t["tenant_id"],
+                "report_id": t["report_id"],
+                "report_version": int(f["version"]),
+                "target_digest": f["target"],
+                # Synthetic shape values only, not a real sequence or replay receipt.
+                "expected_review_seq": 0,
+                "idempotency_key": "test-only-unsaved-preview",
+                "reason": f["reason"] if f["reason"] else None,
+                "dispositions": [
+                    {
+                        "guard_ref": f["guard." + str(i)],
+                        "binding_ref": f["binding." + str(i)],
+                        "pointer": f["pointer." + str(i)],
+                        "disposition": f["disposition." + str(i)],
+                    }
+                    for i in range(len(t["claims"]))
+                ],
+                "sections": [
+                    {"section_id": s, "target_digest": f["section." + s], "acknowledged": True}
+                    for s in t["required_sections"]
+                    if "section." + s in f
+                ],
+            }
+            if is_review:
+                command["action"] = f["action"]
+                proposal = ReviewCommandProposal(canonical(command, limit=COMMAND_LIMIT))
+            else:
+                command.update(
+                    checked_scope=t["scope_digest"], remaining_unknowns=t["limitations_digest"]
+                )
+                proposal = CoverageAcknowledgementProposal(canonical(command, limit=COMMAND_LIMIT))
+            # Pure validation only. Do not issue a digest receipt or simulate commit.
+            try:
+                validate_proposal(proposal, ReviewTarget(canonical(t)))
+                outcome = "CONTRACT_VALID_ONLY"
+            except ReviewError as exc:
+                outcome = exc.code
+            return task, dossier, command, outcome
+        except (ConsoleError, ReviewError):
+            raise
+        except (ValueError, UnicodeError, TypeError, KeyError):
+            refuse("INVALID_INPUT")
+
+    def post(self, context, target, raw, content_type, *, prefix):
+        """Only the harness calls this after HTTP Host/Origin/body checks.
+
+        ConsoleInterface.dispatch and ConsoleService.mutate still always deny POST.
+        """
+        self._context(context)
+        url = urlsplit(target)
+        if (
+            len(target) > 2048
+            or url.scheme
+            or url.netloc
+            or url.query
+            or url.fragment
+            or not url.path.startswith(prefix)
+        ):
+            refuse("INVALID_INPUT")
+        parts = unquote(url.path[len(prefix) :], errors="strict").split("/")
+        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[0] != "tasks" or parts[2] != "proposal-preview":
+            refuse("NOT_IMPLEMENTED")
+        return self.validate(context, parts[1], raw, content_type)

+# RA4C2 验收与威胁矩阵
+
+原生提议合同的验证器决定语义；app 只做输入边界、来源重放和展示。所有用例为自动化合成测试，不代表真人验收。最终计数由 XML/原始调用记录与 source-matching receipt 核定。
+
+| 目标/攻击 | 入口与实际验证 | 预期 |
+|---|---|---|
+| 404 6 Claim 候选 | real ReportDraft.load + build/validate_target + ReviewCommandProposal + validate_proposal spy | 合同有效，private/not approved，无真实决定 |
+| 退回/拒绝 | 指定第2 Claim，具体原因，对应整体动作 | 只返回提议预览，无任务阶段变化；mutate deny |
+| 200 3 Claim / 0 issue | CoverageAcknowledgementProposal 实例 + 原生验证 | 独立范围 ACK，native H0/version null；无 APPROVE |
+| missing/foreign/duplicate Claim | 缺失绑定字段、外来 binding、重复三元身份 | 输入拒绝或原生 D_CLAIM_INCOMPLETE |
+| 机器语义提升 | impact → ACK_LITERAL_FACT，空/未知 disposition，candidate 带 change | 原生 D_CLAIM_CEILING；没有新 Guard/证据生成 |
+| missing/extra ACK、错误 target | 少选 section、外来 section、错误 digest | 原生 D_SECTION_INCOMPLETE 或形状拒绝 |
+| 无定位/空/空白原因 | REQUEST_CHANGES/REJECT，缺少对应 Claim 处置 | D_REASON_LOCATION / D_REASON_REQUIRED / D_UNTRUSTED_TEXT |
+| 超长/control/bidi 原因 | 2001字、控制符、方向覆盖符 | 原生拒绝；非法原文不反显 |
+| HTML/JS/body 注入 | HTML/script 作为原因 + 浏览器真实输入提交 | 转义文字，不执行；零外部网络 |
+| 来源/quote/UTF8/Guard/policy | form 打开后修改 native source，实际重放 | SOURCE_INTEGRITY；不回显原文 |
+| stale/version/404→200 | 修改 target、draft、版本、完整 case DTO | STALE/SOURCE_INTEGRITY，不能切换 fixture authority |
+| actor/tenant/assignment | None/dict/Owner/verified/其他 capability、foreign Scope、未分配ID | 先拒绝，来源 port 未调用；不泄漏存在性 |
+| caller trust / URL / production | verified/trusted/owner/actor/tenant/sequence/idempotency/adapter/url 等额外字段 | 形状拒绝，不赋予权限 |
+| HTTP 跨源 | wrong/null/missing/重复 Origin，wrong/重复 Host，cross-site/same-site | 403，原始数据不泄漏 |
+| HTTP body | Cookie/Authorization/TE、重复/缺失长度、超24576、错误/重复类型、非法UTF8/percent/重复字段 | 403/400，不进入业务验证 |
+| 非授权动作 | direct ConsoleInterface POST / service.mutate / HTTP approve/reject/share/export/download | always-deny，无新生产接口 |
+| 无旗标/外部模式 | serve 无双旗标、0.0.0.0；真实 adapter prepare | 拒绝启动/操作 |
+| 原有 Console/QA | 原58 + C1原43 + 原 reviewing127；冻结 V2 64+54 | 原文件同 Git blob，不调整预期 |
+| PG 与隔离 | 新精确HEAD四标准CI + 双PG16 CI，原SQL54+11、容器/worker/browser拒绝 | 实际执行日志与原artifact核验，skip不当pass |
+| 浏览器 1280/375/320 | 真click/select keyboard/中文原因/form POST；source back/forward；重开GET；stale/注入/200ACK | ≥12px提示、≥44px主控件、无横溢；原始CDP/DOM/截图哈希 |
+
+## 保留的初始 RED 与失败
+
+- `evidence/initial-red/`：新增模块尚不存在时的真实 pytest collection RED，原始 XML/log 保留。
+- `browser-2026-11-12T23-16-36-109Z`：真实表单 Origin:null 被403拒绝。修正仅本地表单 Referrer-Policy，不允许 null Origin；后续 HTTP 新增 null 拒绝测试。
+- `browser-2026-11-12T23-18-17-817Z`：21项处因读取折叠合同的 innerText 失败；改为真实点击展开后核对，未改业务预期。此前404动作/篡改检查记录保留，不作为完整三视口通过。
+- 首轮 hosted `43328389718`：标准 Python 3.11/3.13 与隔离浏览器成功，isolated-http 15m14s 超时取消；原始日志/API/Git/artifact 在 `hosted-43328389718-20261113T000234`。冻结防火墙禁止 IPv4 loopback；测试适配器改用 AF_UNIX 驱动原 Handler，并新增真实 loopback 内核拒绝测试。普通环境/浏览器保留真实 TCP，不跳过32项HTTP断言、不修改安全规则或CI。旧双Python323是旧测试源历史，最终要求双324。
+- 第二轮 hosted `43334310380`：isolated-http 10m7s 成功，3.13 8m19s 成功，3.11 固定12m14s超时取消；复用新测试的原生输入模板，逐用例深拷贝，所有真正被测的 native replay/validate_proposal 调用与断言不变，未改生产源码或超时。`python-*-20261113T000607`因准备此测试修复主动中止，不作通过。
+- 旧候选5c9 hosted `43338055464` + `43338055175` 六绿，但真实merge-ref基线已推进558d，与候选tree不同，拒作最终验收。确认Owner合并PR69后普通集成最新main0f4，再双324和新六CI；PG保留原11+54，并用原样的accepted-main PG auditor实际核验新增14pure/P2A86和54兼容重放，原有源码/预期不变。
+
+最终绿轮必须源哈希匹配、全部断言通过；不覆盖失败记录。历史 RA3C V1 RED53 和 Human Gold 0/26 保持封存，不重新标记通过。

+"""Source-matching local receipts and exact-head six hosted checks."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from verify_pg import verify
+
+HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT=HERE.parents[2]
+BASE='558d183624a0a36d1f4eaf9d3d75af73b9c88547'
+
+
+def load(p):
+    return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+
+
+def sha(p):
+    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+python_by_minor={}
+historical=[]
+for folder in sorted((HERE/'evidence').glob('python-*')):
+    if not (folder/'receipt.json').exists():
+        continue
+    r=load(folder/'receipt.json')
+    if not all(sha(ROOT/p)==h for p,h in r['source_sha256'].items()):
+        continue
+    assert r['passed']==324 and r['baseline_app']==58 and r['baseline_c1']==43 and r['new_app']==96
+    assert r['actual_reviewing_receipt']['collected']==r['actual_reviewing_receipt']['called']==r['actual_reviewing_receipt']['passed']==127
+    minor=r['python'].split()[0].split('.')[1]
+    if minor in python_by_minor:
+        historical.append(python_by_minor[minor])
+    python_by_minor[minor]={'directory':folder.name,'head':r['head'],'python':r['python'],'passed':324}
+python=[python_by_minor[k] for k in sorted(python_by_minor)]
+assert len(python)==2
+browser=[]
+for folder in sorted((HERE/'evidence').glob('browser-*')):
+    if (folder/'failure.txt').exists() or not (folder/'receipt.json').exists():
+        continue
+    r=load(folder/'receipt.json')
+    if not all(sha(ROOT/'apps/operator_console'/p)==h for p,h in r['sourceHashes'].items()):
+        continue
+    a=load(folder/'assertions.json')
+    assert len(a)==r['assertions']==r['passed']==75 and all(v['pass'] for v in a)
+    assert len(r['screenshots'])==24 and all(sha(folder/s['file'])==s['sha256'] for s in r['screenshots'])
+    assert not r['serverError']
+    raw=load(folder/'raw-cdp.json')
+    assert len([x for x in raw['network'] if x['request']['method']=='POST'])==21
+    browser.append({'directory':folder.name,'head':r['sourceHead'],'assertions':75,'screenshots':24})
+assert browser
+result={'state':'LOCAL_COMPLETE_FINAL_CI_PENDING','python':python,'browser':browser,'same_source_older_main':historical,

+"""Seal post-CI evidence without mutating the frozen Git head."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import zipfile
+
+HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT=HERE.parents[2]
+destination=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+assert destination.is_relative_to(HERE/'evidence')
+acceptance=json.loads((destination/'ACCEPTANCE.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+assert acceptance['state']=='SIX_CI_GREEN_ENGINEERING_CANDIDATE_NOT_OWNER_FINAL_PASS'
+head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
+assert head==acceptance['final_sha']
+assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','HEAD','--name-only','--','apps/operator_console','tests/operator_console'],cwd=ROOT)
+prefix=HERE.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
+names=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z','--cached','--others','--exclude-standard','--',prefix],cwd=ROOT)
+paths=sorted({ROOT/n.decode() for n in names.split(b'\0') if n})
+excluded={'RA4C2-final-evidence.zip','BUNDLE.json','FINAL-ARTIFACTS.json','PR-BODY.md'}
+paths=[p for p in paths if p.is_file() and p.name not in excluded]
+assert all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(HERE) for p in paths)
+files={p.relative_to(HERE).as_posix():{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                                   'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in paths}
+manifest=destination/'FINAL-ARTIFACTS.json'
+manifest.write_bytes(json.dumps({'final_sha':head,'files':files},indent=2).encode()+b'\n')
+paths.append(manifest)
+archive=destination/'RA4C2-final-evidence.zip'
+with zipfile.ZipFile(archive,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
+    for p in paths:
+        z.write(p,p.relative_to(HERE).as_posix())
+record={'final_sha':head,'file':archive.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+        'bytes':archive.stat().st_size,'members':len(paths),'post_ci_no_head_drift':True}
+(destination/'BUNDLE.json').write_bytes(json.dumps(record,indent=2).encode()+b'\n')
+print(json.dumps(record))
